name: Public Holidays
tagline: Official public holidays for any country and year
description: Get the list of official public holidays for any country and year. Shows date, English name, local name, and holiday type. Covers 100+ countries. Uses the free Nager.Date API — no API key required.

inputs.name: country_code
inputs.label: Country Code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
inputs.placeholder: US or DE or FR or GB

expert_defs.name: public_holidays_get
expert_defs.description: Returns official public holidays for a country and year using date.nager.at. Params: country_code (2-letter ISO code like US/DE/FR), year (4-digit year, defaults to current year). Returns JSON with output_type json containing list of holidays.
code: yr = year.strip() if year.strip() else str(datetime.date.today().year)
holidays = [{'date': h.get('date'), 'name': h.get('localName', h.get('name', '')), 'name_en': h.get('name', ''), 'type': ', '.join(h.get('types', ['Public']))} for h in data]

conceptTexts: Plugin: Public Holidays (id: public-holidays). Expert public_holidays_get returns official public holidays using date.nager.at (free). Params: country_code (2-letter ISO like US/DE/FR), year (defaults to current). Returns {output_type: 'json', data: {country, year, count, holidays: [{date, name, name_en, type}]}}.
